item.title: C++ practices
item.description: Most rules presented here cover the same things as the very good C++ Core Guidelines. Whenever something is not covered or you are in doubt - don’t hesitate to consult it - it is a very good source of information.

item.title: Code Formatting Guidelines
item.description: FreeCAD is written primarily in C++ and Python (with a few files in other languages such as CMake). To smooth the process of merging new contributions it is desirable to minimize formatting changes to existing code, and to use a uniform code formatting style when writing new code. Eventually we expect to standardize the codebase on specific coding styles using Clang Format for C++ and a Python code-formatter (such as Black), but that is a work-in-progress and should not be applied to existing otherwise-untouched code.

item.title: Code Review Guide
item.description: This document aims to provide set of good practices that should be helpful for both developers and code reviewers. They should be treated like food recipes - you can play with them, alter them - but every change should be thoughtful and intentional.
